:::caution
This rule is part of the [nursery](/linter/#nursery) group. This means that it is experimental and the behavior can change at any time.
:::
## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.5.12`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/noBunModules`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule doesn't have a fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**warning**](/reference/diagnostics#warning).
## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noBunModules": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Forbid the use of Bun builtin modules.

This can be useful for client-side web projects that don't have access to those modules.

The rule doesn't trigger if there are dependencies declared in the `package.json` that match
the name of a built-in Bun module.

Type-only imports are ignored.

## Examples

### Invalid

```js
import { Database } from "bun:sqlite";
```

### Valid

```js
import { Database } from "custom-sqlite";
```

```ts
import type { DatabaseOptions } from "bun:sqlite";
```
